title: Due date: the earliest candidate wins; compliance = the certificate End date
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with View customers, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. An asset is enrolled with a mileage-triggered service and you can seed exact dated readings (e.g. unit 'ZZAUTOTEST Truck 12'). Compute the expected values by hand to check the product.
custom_steps:
1. Seed a service with a calendar candidate and an earlier mileage candidate; read the Due date.
  2. On a compliance service, read the Due date against the certificate's End date.
  3. Confirm due-soon / due-today / overdue fall on the right days.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Due is the earliest candidate across the service's active triggers.
  • A compliance service is due on its current certificate's End date; it reads due soon from its Remind before expiry, due today on that day and overdue from the next day.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10568 (S12, Due date resolution); Chunk 2 MR spec (Confluence 897679389), Part 2 / S12 (Rule 116); read 2 Oct 2026. Source-verified 2 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-R5: “Due will be the earliest candidate”
  • S12-R4: “A compliance service is due on its current certificate's End date. It reads due soon from its Remind before expiry, due today on that day and overdue from the next day”
